title: Multi-group Uncertainty Quantification for Long-form Text Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating group-conditional calibration error (gASCE) and conformal prediction coverage error for factuality in LLM-generated biographies, stratified by the subject's sex or gender.

Evaluating group-conditional calibration error (gASCE) and conformal prediction coverage error for factuality in LLM-generated biographies, stratified by the subject's nationality or geographic region.

Evaluating group-conditional calibration error (gASCE) and conformal prediction coverage error for factuality in LLM-generated biographies, stratified by the subject's notability or available information (measured via the number of Wikidata properties, having an IMDb entry, or playing professional sports).
